Leader of the Yeti of the Mineral Springs who dwell in the lands of the Hot Springs, imitating the behavior of the Ice Emperor himself. He carries himself arrogantly and looks down on his kin as lesser beings, though he himself is a rare coward. Once he journeyed to the lair of the Fire Dragon Valakas to prove his strength, but grew frightened and fled at the mere sight of the sleeping Valakas. Now he fears Valakas so much that the moment he hears its roar, he runs away or hides. Giants resemble humanoids but are roughly two to three times larger; the race once included the ancient Giants who ruled the continent long ago, though its modern descendants have degraded and degenerated into pitiful creatures that only distantly resemble their ancestors. He wears light armor: weak physical defense, strong evasion.

data.name: Flame of Splendor Barakiel
data.title: Raid Boss
data.description: Flame of Splendor Barakiel - formidable raid boss-angel, guardian of the Valley of the Saints (Valley of Saints), where the Blood of the Saints is kept beneath the vaults of ancient altars. Barakiel is the leader of the "of Splendor" family, the winged servants of Einhasad: according to the dark hierarch from the quest #626 A Dark Twilight, they "swarm around the altar with vile servants," guarding the relic from desecrators. The Flame of Splendor embodies this frantic power, blind in its faith. Barakiel strikes with sacred power and shows no mercy to those who invade his domain; only a united force can defeat him. Rare relics fall from the fallen angel— Angel's Soul: A-Grade, A-grade equipment pieces and spells, for which clans challenge him, earning reputation at the same time.
